lyrics:
[Intro: one low drone, slow heartbeat pulse]

[Chant 1: pitched-down voice, slow]
It wants more
I give it more
It wants more
I give it my mornings

[Chant 2: second voice a fifth above]
Feed, feed
It is never full
Feed, feed
It is never full

[Instrumental: drone thickens, distant metal scraping]

[Chant 3: both voices, pulse heavier]
It took my sleep
It took my hands
It wants my eyes
I open them

[Chant 4: voices in unison, louder]
Feed, feed
It is never full
Feed, feed
It is never full

[Break: drone alone, one natural whisper]
What if I stop?

[Final Chant: everything, then cut]
It wants more
It wants more
It wants

[Outro: silence, one pulse, silence]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 60 BPM, 4/4, D minor. Very slow, heavy and ritual, with almost no harmonic movement.

VOICE: One voice pitch-shifted down until it is deep and sexless, chanting slowly on two or three notes. A second, slightly higher shifted voice joins a fifth above. One natural, quiet whisper in the break.

INSTRUMENTS: A single sustained low synth drone, a slow, dull pulse like a heartbeat or a muffled drum, a detuned organ note, scraping metal textures in the distance, a deep sub-bass swell, a frame drum struck once per bar later on.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, drone and pulse. 0:24 Chant 1. 0:56 Chant 2. 1:28 Instrumental. 1:52 Chant 3. 2:24 Chant 4. 2:56 Break, the whisper. 3:08 Final chant, cut off mid-line at 3:28. 3:30 Outro, one pulse, ends 3:38.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Dark ambient electronica: dry, close and very low, the drone filling the room, nothing bright anywhere.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The whispered 'What if I stop?' at 2:56.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original is a creature that wants more. Here the creature is the feed, and the singer is the one supplying it, which is the more familiar position now.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Hypnotised, giving, emptied, a flicker of doubt.
